what: The one install limit a person can change, kept here because three things need the same number: the installer enforces it, SETTINGS > FILES shows and sets it, and tools/build-blockers.mjs decides from it whether a repository gets a 'too many files' note. Three copies of a number is how a note comes to describe a limit that is no longer there.
measured: E9-72, over all 351 repositories the catalogue lists: exactly one is over 400 files, and it is mosaic at 1209. The next largest is pirate-radio at 239. So 400 refused one script in 355 and 2000 refuses none, with room for a repository that grows and for the submodules a listing does not mention. The other limits in install.ts are about BYTES and are unchanged: a repository that is a sample library is still stopped by MAX_AUDIO_TOTAL, which is the thing that was actually worth stopping.
